notes: GAAP audit. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); bond proceeds 1,530,000 are printed among revenues (inside Total revenues), so recorded as a receipt line (Bond Proceeds). Transfers: Total column prints one net line 'Transfers from (to) other funds' 50,274 (in), recorded as transfers_in as printed. Roll-forward 2,882,682 + 5,564,490 - 5,219,445 + 50,274 = 3,278,001 ties. Ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents 3,252,523 on the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4) Total column; county treasurer cash 39,472 separate (as in FY2023/FY2024); beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7) Total column, cost-type lines with function utilities; 'Other revenue' 16,254 counted in Charges for Services by the Statement of Activities (p2); grant income 184,598 (nonoperating, capital grants and contributions on p3) recorded as receipt, grantor not printed; receipts total = operating 901,196 + nonoperating 184,598 (computed); expenses 877,577 as printed on the Statement of Activities p2. Business roll-forward 5,600,762 + 1,085,794 - 877,577 - 50,274 = 5,758,705 ties. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) by Governmental / Business-type column. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp13-16, 19 department columns; no budget column), which is more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p9, not recorded, as in FY2023); department functions follow the statement's function split, which ties exactly: general government 474,544 = Administrative (excl. economic development and capital outlay) + Municipal Building + Grants + Employee Insurance + Equipment repairs; public safety 249,177 = Police + Rescue + Fire Maintenance (excl. capital); public works 104,400 = Street Lighting + Tree Dump + Cemetery (excl. capital); environment and leisure 799,785; economic development 123,824 = Administrative 64,468 + Sales Tax 59,356; capital outlay 511,254. Capital outlay lines labelled with a function only where the department names one (Administrative, Fire Maintenance, Library); Equipment, Sales Tax and Cemetery capital outlay kept plain. Activity & Education charges for services kept as generic charges (department name does not establish recreation fees). Street, Debt Service and Capital Projects funds from their budgetary comparison schedules (pp10-12); lines with no actual (Street capital outlay budget 259,000; Debt Service interest income budget 1,000) not recorded; net transfers are outside the printed totals. No Sales Tax fund in FY2022 (sales tax department inside the General Fund). No business-type detail schedules (as in FY2023). Read pages 1-16 of 16
